_comment: Copy to workflow.config.json and keep only the agents you use. Any agent can fill any role, with one limit: the researcher must be a 'cli' or 'human' agent because it edits files and runs code. See docs/orchestration.md.

claude-code._comment: Claude Code headless mode. Different tool permissions per role.

codex-readonly-reviewer._comment: A reviewer in a read-only sandbox prints its critique; the orchestrator saves it.

gemini-cli._comment: Example only: check the non-interactive flags of your installed version.

claude-api._comment: Claude through the Anthropic SDK (pip install anthropic). Reviewer role only. Credentials from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an `ant auth login` profile.

openai-api._comment: Any OpenAI chat-completions endpoint (pip install openai). Reviewer role only. Set model to an id your account offers.

local-model._comment: A local or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server (for example Ollama or vLLM).

domain-expert._comment: A person fills the role; tasks arrive in the project inbox.
